simple.summary: עָרַב (ʻârab) means to grow dusky at sundown First listed occurrence: 1Sam 17 16.

definitions.full: H6150. arab [ עָרַב ] verb denominative become evening; grow dark (?); — Qal. Infinitive construct לַעֲרוֺב הַיּוֺם רָפָה Judg 19:9 , but read probably ᵐ5 לַעֶרֶב הַיּוֺם נָטָה L GFM; Perfect 3feminine singular figurative עָֽרְבָה Isa 24:11 all joy has grown dark , but read עָֽבְרָה has passed away Lo Gr Perles Anal. 91 Che Hpt and others Hiph`il Infinitive absolute וְהַעֲרֵב הַשְׁכֵּם 1Sam 17:16 doing it at morning and at evening.
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root (rather identical with 6148 through the idea of covering with a texture);
